verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing documents a balance-based (prefunded) funding model where finance pushes funds from an external bank account (stripe-issuing-docs-9), and separately documents real-time authorization webhooks that let a system approve/decline each authorization synchronously, which is the core of just-in-time funding control (stripe-issuing-docs-4). However, the evidence never explicitly frames these as two alternative 'prefunded vs JIT' funding models nor discusses the cash-flow tradeoffs between them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation contrasting prefunded balance funding vs JIT funding as named options, and cash-flow tradeoff guidance for finance leads.
